details: frint is a malicious PyPI package used in the ChocoPoC campaign, in which fake CVE proof-of-concept repositories on GitHub target vulnerability researchers. The PoCs list frint in their requirements; installing it pulls in skytext, whose native extension (gradient.so / gradient.pyd) drops a loader that retrieves the ChocoPoC Python RAT. frint appeared on PyPI about a month before the first PoC was reported and was published from an unverified email address. YesWeHack and Sekoia (2026-07-01) give the SHA-256 of frint 0.1.2 as 17997e9e0256d0f5d5d21a4852c37f16b338e4bb9c2bec09bdfd822b24aa76b4. The package has been removed from PyPI.
